title: When the Static Sings
author: Tamsin Okonkwo
blurb: Rosalind Thackeray, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
